label: FIXTURE — the REAL catalog answer over one real workflow store (tests/test_workflow_phase_answers.py WP2), projected by the real server (parseEnvelope, buildOfficeView, buildDiOfficeStateMessage); evidences nothing about any live Mission

derived_from.edit: the envelope response set to the answer, its requested_at to the answer’s own now; nothing in the answer edited

coverage.statement: Members are the roster of each Mission's direct task and of the child tasks recorded for it (chain depth 1).
coverage.linkedChildStatement: Linked child roles are covered at depth 1; a child's own children are depth-limited (counted, not followed).

categories.label: Blockers
categories.statement: Mission Core's active blockers and its holds on verified success, members reporting blocked activity, the DI-progression pause flag, and a workflow-authority workflow whose declared phase is BLOCKED. Each cause is listed separately.
categories.backing: contract v2: mission_state.report.blockers (active, hard_active), completion.holds and the declared missions[].workflow_phase (workflow_authority.workflow_phase/2 records only); contract v1 and v2: members[].activity, native.paused (Mission Core)

categories.label: Clarification
categories.statement: Not reported: no field of the catalog query contract, at contract version 1 or 2, carries a clarification request, so this desk cannot show one. Coordination routing can record CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED, but the catalog does not read coordination records and no running service writes them yet (it depends on the Operator request route).
categories.backing: none at contract versions 1 and 2 (coordination route records are not projected by the catalog)

categories.label: Authorization / reauthorization
categories.statement: A Mission Core Mission awaiting a human decision (its own pending_decisions fact), or a workflow-authority workflow whose DECLARED phase is NEEDS_REAUTHORIZATION. The two models stay separate: Mission Core has no workflow phase, and nothing about one is read into the other. The display-only lifecycle state is never decided on.
categories.backing: contract v2: mission_state.report.pending_decisions (awaiting_decision, revision, live_authorization, next_permitted_step), Mission Core records; contract v2: the declared missions[].workflow_phase, workflow_authority.workflow_phase/2 records

categories.label: Failed verification
categories.statement: Mission Core reports a contradiction or a withdrawn verified success, or holds contradicted or drifted evidence (evidence_contradicted, candidate_drifted, baseline_drifted — read directly, since Mission Core flags those as contradicted only once a Mission is verified or reported complete), or the canonical review record was refused, is not linkage-corroborated, or carries a parsed REJECT. Not yet verified is not a failure; an unparsed review gate is not a rejection.
categories.backing: contract v2: mission_state.report.completion (contradicted, closure_verified, verified_success, holds) and admitted_artifacts.canonical_review (state, problem, integrity, gate, verdict)

categories.label: Results ready for review
categories.statement: The task source reports COMPLETE while Mission Core has not verified success. That is a report — not task, Mission, verification or delivery completion.
categories.backing: contract v2: mission_state.report.completion (reported_complete, verified_success) with canonical_review gate, task_status and candidate_applicability shown verbatim

categories.label: Delivery awaiting a separate decision
categories.statement: Delivery proposals that were presented through the Grok Bot route and have no recorded authorization yet. Read only from the catalog's delivery_presentations block (contract version 2), joined to the registered PR delivery store. Covers proposals presented through the Grok Bot route only, the most recent 16 that route keeps. A proposal presented directly from the command line (present-dots) is not stored anywhere, so it cannot appear here: a missing entry is not proof that no delivery is awaiting a decision.
categories.backing: contract v2: response.delivery_presentations (proposal digest, presented_at, expires_at, mode, repository URL, the named Mission workflow id, state, link); Grok Bot delivery_presentations map and PR delivery store, both read-only and explicitly registered

causes.label: Workflow authority: this workflow needs reauthorization (phase NEEDS_REAUTHORIZATION)

entries.route: Outside this office: a decision or reauthorization is made through the existing Operator decision route for this Mission. This desk is read-only; it cannot approve, and hiding an entry is not a decision.

sourceCoverage.label: Delivery proposals presented through the Grok Bot
sourceCoverage.statement: This catalog was started without a delivery-presentations source, so no Grok Bot presentations are read. That is not "none". Covers proposals presented through the Grok Bot route only, the most recent 16 that route keeps. A proposal presented directly from the command line (present-dots) is not stored anywhere, so it cannot appear here: a missing entry is not proof that no delivery is awaiting a decision.

reception.refreshStatement: Refreshed with the office feed (no polling of its own); the backend asks for at most one read every 5 s.
reception.dismissalStatement: Hiding an entry is a preference of this view only: it writes nothing, resolves nothing and approves nothing. The entry returns while its record is present (always on reload) and as soon as its canonical content changes.
